def: to follow near, i.e. (figuratively) attend (as a result), trace out, conform to
kjv: attain, follow, fully know, have understanding

occurrences.text: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;
It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,
If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,
